ns2:course.label: Human Rights
ns2:course.description: (SOC 357) Examines the idea of human rights: human rights in liberal democracies, especially in the United States; in pre-industrial societies; in totalitarian states. Studies human rights and cultural evolution; justification of human rights. 3 undergraduate hours. 2 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: SOC 100 or consent of instructor.
